why: Alert levels said in words (as speech-to-text may write them): 'alert level two' with the airport in it raises the alert and its incident, 'alert level three' upgrades, 'alert level one' downgrades (the incident stays). The same words on a talkgroup that isn't a fire one are never heard by the watch.

text: 60 Control, car 9901, declaring an alert level 2 for a Citation at the airport, runway 34
60 Control, car 9901, declaring an alert level two at the airport for a King Air, runway one six
60 Control, car 9901, upgrade to an alert level three, the King Air is reporting smoke
60 Control, car 9901, downgrade to an alert level one, smoke is cleared
